meta.name: tin_coast_camp
meta.prompt: A Bronze Age tin-mining camp on a frozen tundra coast in midwinter: pit heads, smelting fires, hide tents and a beached trading ship.

programs.brief: A Bronze Age wooden coastal trading vessel with ribbed clinker hull, mast, and steerboard, beached high in the frozen shoreline ice and gravel with ballast stones and supply casks around the keel.
An open-cast Bronze Age tin ore trench cut into the frozen ground with timber shoring, gravel spoil mounds, ore washing channels, and log ladders.

tokens.terrain: a frozen tundra coast with snowbound cliffs and an icy beach meeting open cold sea
tokens.icons: open tin-mining pit heads, charcoal burning pits, bronze smelting hearths, hide-and-timber tents, ore slag heaps, and a beached coastal trading vessel on the icy shore
tokens.infra: cart_track through the snow from the pit heads to the smelting hearths; log skids down to the beached ship on the shoreline
